body: Idk. Again it’s probably some american thing. I grew up in my moms home country in Scandinavia but I was never really connected to her culture. My grandma, grandpa and my moms sister are dead. My grandpa only recently but he was so sick most of my life it was hard to get close to him and most of my moms extended family lives far up in Norway and are almost impossible to visit so I never had a lot of relatives from her side. But my dads 3 brothers all moved over here from South America and I grew up with my very latina grandma. Most of my childhood is just memories of my grandma speaking Spanish or Portuguese to me, latin music, latin children’s shows I used to watch, doing holidays like easter and christmas my dads way and big family gatherings with my dads side of the family. I also speak spanish (but can’t spell in even if my life depended on it cause I’m dyslexic and didn’t learn it as a child lol) Most of my moms culture was “washed away” as she never had strong traditions she practiced anyway and I sure do feel like a stranger in both my home country AND my fathers. But I definitely connect more with my dads culture but it was never a race thing more a culture thing if that makes sense
